verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI lets you sign in with a Google account instead of managing API keys (gh-13), but community reports show that an existing Gemini Pro subscription does not grant extra usage in Gemini CLI — users must be on a separate 'Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise' plan, and Workspace accounts can be blocked from login entirely (gemini-cli-comm-3, gemini-cli-comm-4). Users also explicitly ask for a unified subscription across Gemini products, indicating none currently exists (gemini-cli-comm-19). Missing for 10: evidence that any existing consumer subscription (e.g., Gemini Advanced/Pro) actually unlocks full CLI usage without a separate paid tier.
